label: t03_01
text: When your Pokémon are hurt, heal them!\nWhen you see a shop, buy up supplies!\c\nThose habits are the key to happy adventuring.

label: t03_03
text: We use this truck to transport the olives we grow.\c\nYou wouldn’t believe how busy things get come\nharvest season!

label: t03_14
text: Oooh, these sweets they sell at Soapberry!\nThey’re sooo good—and super popular!

label: t03_15
text:
Our Gym Leader here in Cortondo is the battling
baker herself, Katy!\c
Don’t let her sweet looks fool you into letting
down your guard!

label: t03_16
text: You’ve come to Cortondo right in the middle of\nour Olive Harvest Festival. The Gym Test here\r\nserves as a part of the festival, too!

label: t03_17
text: Roll, roll, roll! Ta-da!\c\nTarountula wraps itself up in its string to protect\nitself from attackers, y’know!

label: t03_23
text: This is Cortondo. It’s a nice round-sounding\nname, isn’t it? Like a lovely olive!

label: t03_28
text: I’ve heard that Vivillon look different based on\nwhere they’re from...\c\nSo I wonder where these fellows came from?

label: t03_39
text: From here, you can enjoy a nice cup of tea while\nwatching the Gym Leader battle challengers.
